caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of ornate furniture resembling a small wooden cabinet or sewing table with two cylindrical drawers, each fitted with two round, light-colored knobs. The cabinet is dark brown with a wood grain texture and has a rectangular, flat top. The base of the cabinet features two intricately carved, dark wooden supports on either side, shaped with stylized scrolling leaf or acanthus motifs, and gold-colored rods connecting the supports in the center. Below the supports, there is an additional rectangular base adorned with carved floral or leaf decorations in the front. The furniture piece rests on four carved legs that resemble animal paws, each positioned at a diagonal angle. The entire structure is rendered with shading to show depth and highlights, and the object is presented against a light beige background with a thin border near the image’s edges.
title: Table - Double Lyre Base
